title: Financial Counseling Schedule: Recent Payments and the Hardship Waiver Share
content:
Larkfield's hardship relief on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program weighs the customer's own payments on the account.

**Schedule.** The payment share is 0.8 when no patient payment was posted on the program within the last 6 calendar months, 0.9 when one was posted within the last 6 calendar months but none within the last 3, and 1 otherwise, when a payment was posted within the last 3 calendar months.

Before the ceilings and the rounding apply, the waiver — the waivable cost share less the balance adjustments already posted against the named posting — is multiplied by the payment share.

A payment falls within the last N calendar months when its posting date is later than the same calendar day N months earlier.

| Latest patient payment on the program | Payment share |
|---|---|
| within the last 3 calendar months | 1 |
| within the last 6 calendar months, none within the last 3 | 0.9 |
| none within the last 6 calendar months | 0.8 |

**Boundaries (hypothetical: today is 20 September)**

- A payment posted 21 June is within the last 3 calendar months; one posted 20 June is not.
- A payment posted 21 March is within the last 6 calendar months; one posted 20 March is not.

**Example (hypothetical).** Waivable cost share 50.00, latest payment four months ago: 50.00 times 0.9, that is 45.00.
